summary: Repaired R3 and related acceptance/task wording so draft-gate guidance is verified through prompt source and next-action output, not generated skill artifacts.

items.title: Generated skill artifact target contradicts dispatcher architecture
items.rationale: The spec now treats `src/flow/prompts/plan/draft-gate.md` and rendered `sdd-forge flow get next-action` output as the runtime guidance targets. Generated skill artifacts are mentioned only as dispatcher behavior and are not required to inline draft-gate prompt text.
